audit_status.source_base: Hebrew 1 Chronicles / Divrei Hayamim Aleph priestly and Levitical divisions, first-pass restored draft; later witness audit required
audit_status.review_note: Reviewed for Nadab and Abihu, hereditary priesthood, proportional divisions, lots, scribal transparency, old/young equality, and textual variants.

verses.restored: Divisions of sons of Aaron: sons of Aaron were Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

familiar.text: Now these are the divisions of the sons of Aaron. The sons of Aaron; Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

verses.restored: Nadab and Abihu died before their father and had no children; Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests.

familiar.text: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and had no children: therefore Eleazar and Ithamar executed the priest’s office.

verses.restored: David, with Zadok from sons of Eleazar and Ahimelech from sons of Ithamar, divided them according to appointed service.

familiar.text: And David distributed them, both Zadok of the sons of Eleazar, and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, according to their offices in their service.

verses.restored: More chief men were found among sons of Eleazar than sons of Ithamar, so they divided them: sixteen ancestral heads from Eleazar and eight from Ithamar.

familiar.text: And there were more chief men found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar; and thus were they divided. Among the sons of Eleazar there were sixteen chief men of the house of their fathers, and eight among the sons of Ithamar according to the house of their fathers.

verses.restored: They divided them by lot, these with those, because officials of sanctuary and officials of Divine house came from both Eleazar and Ithamar.

familiar.text: Thus were they divided by lot, one sort with another; for the governors of the sanctuary, and governors of the house of God, were of the sons of Eleazar, and of the sons of Ithamar.

verses.restored: Shemaiah son of Nethanel, Levite scribe, wrote them before king, leaders, Zadok the priest, Ahimelech son of Abiathar, and ancestral heads of priests and Levites, one ancestral house drawn for Eleazar and then one for Ithamar.

translation_notes: Nadab and Abihu's death belongs to a sacred-violence tradition and must not be used to terrorize religious workers or children.
Hereditary priesthood describes an ancient system and does not authorize modern caste, nepotism, or male-only spiritual authority.
Lots distribute work; they are not magical guarantees of Divine approval and require transparent, revisable administration.
Shemaiah's written record before multiple witnesses is a constructive accountability practice.
Equal treatment of chief and younger households limits seniority privilege, though labor consent and conditions remain unstated.
Childlessness is recorded administratively and does not diminish a person's worth.
Names and family relationships contain textual variants requiring witness audit.
safety_note: Do not use priestly divisions to justify clerical caste, fear-based ritual control, nepotism, male supremacy, or divination by lots. Preserve transparent records, equal dignity, accountability, and safe working conditions.
